rows: torus113_bust
README claim 4: wrapped (1,1),(0,3), bust share 0.9369 (qsd.c halffall_share K=6: a fall of ≥ ⌈A/2⌉ cells in one generation among the last 6 transitions).

bustShare 6 μ λ ∈ (0.936852, 0.936853) for every QSD with λ > 0. bustShare is defined as 1 - μ·noBust 6 / (λ^5 (1-λ)); that this is the share of the death flux is the stationarity argument in DiceExit.lean's header, in prose, not formalised (it is now a theorem in path form: `flux_share`, `torus113_bust_flux`). The share is the stationary share of the death flux (deaths from the quasi-stationary law), not the share of all deaths from a fixed start (on this torus, from state 73, that share is 0.934, ref-dice second review).

section: Second task, 2026-11-24 14:00–15:30 UTC: the exits as path statements; Theorem 1 on every hull face (mathlib/GumpMath/DiceFlux.lean, DiceHull.lean, DiceBound3.lean, DiceHullAll.lean)
rows: flux_share
rigour/README.md claim 4 and qsd.c halffall_share: the share of the quasi-stationary death flux whose last K transitions contain a fall of at least half the face.

Path form, every generation: for every QSD (μ, λ) with 0 < λ < 1, K ≥ 1, m ≥ 0, P_μ(T = m+K, bust in the last K) / P_μ(T = m+K) = bustShare K μ λ, with paths summed explicitly (pathE: every list of m+K states with the product of its transition probabilities). Replaces the prose step of DiceExit.lean. The sum over all generations is not formed (every generation has the same ratio). The share is the stationary share of the death flux (deaths from the quasi-stationary law), not the share of all deaths from a fixed start (from the full hull face it is about 0.152, ref-dice).
